manifest.title: Turbo Circuit: Car Snakes & Ladders
manifest.description: High-octane car racing board game inspired by Snakes & Ladders! Navigate 50 racetrack tiles with Turbo Boost ramps, beware of oil slick spinouts, and customize the race with 5 thrilling mutators.

availableMutators.name: 1. Classic Grand Prix (1d6)
availableMutators.description: Roll 1d6, advance step-by-step along the 50-tile track. Use turbo ramps and avoid oil slicks.

availableMutators.name: 2. Nitro Target (1d60 Full Range)
availableMutators.description: Roll 1d60! Your car leaps directly to the rolled number. If you roll > 50, you overshoot and lose your turn! Hit 50 to win.

availableMutators.name: 3. Nitro Assist (1d60 Forward Only)
availableMutators.description: Roll 1d60, but the lower roll value is locked to your current position. No backtracking! Faster race to the finish (roll > 50 still loses turn).

availableMutators.name: 4. Reverse Hazard Overdrive
availableMutators.description: Oil slicks grant nitro drift boosts forward (+distance), while turbo ramps overheat and send cars back into pit lane!

availableMutators.name: 5. Custom Grid & Dice Loadout
availableMutators.description: Staggered starting grid (e.g. pole positions 1, 2, 3, 4) and custom dice assigned to each player (1d2 to 1d100).

connections.title: Oil Spill Spinout
connections.description: Car spins out of control (-12 tiles)!

connections.title: Tire Blowout
connections.description: Pushed back to the repair bay (-17 tiles)!

connections.title: Final Corner Crash
connections.description: Devastating barrier collision near the finish (-23 tiles)!

rulesDescription: Roll the dice to navigate through 50 track tiles. Land on Turbo Boost ramps to jump ahead, avoid Oil Slicks, or try Nitro Target mode with 1d60!
